Text.Text: The crooked game is over. Aces and eights are a better hand when the one holding them is still breathing. You've finished my Dead Man's Hand trials. I have no further work for you here.
The buy-in is rank 50 in Pistol. Train until you meet it, then we'll talk about the canyon job.

A crew in the canyon is teaching my shooting and selling its own cheats. Bring me their tally; I want to know who's playing at my old table. Defeat six Dead Man's Hand Adepts in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Dead Man's Hand Canyon Range Tally; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash. I'll give you the Anchorhead Canyon Range Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Dead Man's Hand.

Here's the Anchorhead Canyon Range Key. Use 'Anchorhead Canyon Range' in Tatooine, Anchorhead, North Entrance. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Dead Man's Hand Adepts, then return with the Dead Man's Hand Canyon Range Tally.

The draw you make when you're already beaten. The table says you're dead, everyone's counting their winnings, and your hand moves anyway. It isn't luck, friend. It's refusing to die on someone else's count.

Use 'Anchorhead Canyon Range' in Tatooine, Anchorhead, North Entrance. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Dead Man's Hand Adepts in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Dead Man's Hand Canyon Range Tally; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash.
Six adepts holding low pairs and betting like aces. They'll crowd you, all smiles and spread fingers. Smile back. Then take the pot one hand at a time.
Defeat six Dead Man's Hand Adepts in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Dead Man's Hand Canyon Range Tally; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash.
You've defeated six Dead Man's Hand Adepts. Let me see the Dead Man's Hand Canyon Range Tally.
The book is back in honest hands. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists have turned my sightlines into ambush lanes. Take back their calibrator. Defeat five Dead Man's Hand Specialists in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Dead Man's Hand Sightline Calibrator; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash.
Your key still grants access to Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Defeat five Dead Man's Hand Specialists to secure the Dead Man's Hand Sightline Calibrator, then return to me.

Mine, once. I dealt at that range for years and taught the draw to anyone whose credits were good. A few of them had good credits and bad hearts. They kept my deck, marked every card in it, and now they deal my game to killers. A man should retire his own deck. I intend to.
On the market, a stack of credits. To them, every rigged angle in the canyon. To me, the difference between a duel and an execution. I've dealt both, friend. Only one of them lets me sleep.
Patient. A sharp never bets early. They'll let you walk the long lanes thinking the table's cold, then show the whole hand at once. Make them bet first. Then raise.

Defeat five Dead Man's Hand Specialists in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Dead Man's Hand Sightline Calibrator; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash.
You've defeated five Dead Man's Hand Specialists. Let me see the Dead Man's Hand Sightline Calibrator.
One less rigged test to worry about. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden is protecting the crew's game. Beat him and bring back the crest he wears. Defeat the Dead Man's Hand Warden in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Dead Man's Hand Shattered Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Dead Man's Hand Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Dead Man's Hand Shattered Range Crest.

He ran security at my table before he ran the table itself. Never bluffs, never tilts, never draws first, and he's never needed to draw twice. That crest used to mean the range was safe. Now it means the range is his.
In Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Dead Man's Hand Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Dead Man's Hand Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Dead Man's Hand Warden in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Dead Man's Hand Shattered Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Dead Man's Hand Warden. Let me see the Dead Man's Hand Shattered Range Crest.
The warden's protection is broken. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four at the high table hold the marshal's challenge chit. Take it, and we can call the master out. Defeat four members of the Dead Man's Hand Inner Circle in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Dead Man's Hand Marshal's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash.
Your key still grants access to Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Defeat four members of the Dead Man's Hand Inner Circle to secure the Dead Man's Hand Marshal's Challenge Chit, then return to me.

Two killers, a bookkeeper who shoots better than the killers, and the woman who marked my deck in the first place. They've banked every crooked game down there for years. Nothing moves without their cut.

Old range law, friend. Lay that chit on the marshal's table and the marshal must play you. No guards, no tolls, no folding. The man upstairs holds my old title and hasn't honored a chit in years. We're going to make him.
As a syndicate. Four hands, one pot, and they'll spend each other's lives before their own. Bring the same two who watched your back in the pit. Four against three is closer odds than they'd like.

Defeat four members of the Dead Man's Hand Inner Circle in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Dead Man's Hand Marshal's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash.
You've defeated four members of the Dead Man's Hand Inner Circle. Let me see the Dead Man's Hand Marshal's Challenge Chit.
That closes the crew's account. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master has answered the challenge. This is the last hand: defeat him in the Canyon Dueling Pit. Defeat the Dead Man's Hand Master in Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit. Report back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Dead Man's Hand Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

My partner, once. We dealt that range together and split every pot even. Then I caught him dealing seconds to a boy who died of it, and I walked. He kept the table, the title, and the hand I taught him. That pot's been sitting there for years, friend. I'm finally calling.
In Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Dead Man's Hand Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

You'll put him down, and his hand will move anyway. That's the trick of it, the draw that comes after the beating. First time you see it, you freeze. So don't be the only one at the table. Three guns means when that dead hand moves, somebody's already answering.

Defeat the Dead Man's Hand Master in Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit. Report back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Club d'Ash; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Dead Man's Hand Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The crooked game is over. Aces and eights are a better hand when the one holding them is still breathing. You've earned the right to train Dead Man's Hand. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the game.
I'll defeat six Dead Man's Hand Adepts.
What exactly is the Dead Man's Hand?
Where's this table of yours?
What are the adepts holding?
I'll pass this hand.
Here's the Dead Man's Hand Canyon Range Tally.
Back to the sharps.
I'll defeat five Dead Man's Hand Specialists.
Whose game is this, really?
What's the calibrator worth?
How do the specialists play?
I'm sitting this one out.
Here's the Dead Man's Hand Sightline Calibrator.
Back to the pit boss.
I'll defeat the Dead Man's Hand Warden.
What do you know about the warden?
Where's the deep range?
Would you recommend bringing help?
I fold. For now.
Here's the Dead Man's Hand Shattered Range Crest.
Back to the high table.
I'll defeat four members of the Dead Man's Hand Inner Circle.
Who sits at the high table?
What does the chit buy, exactly?
How does the circle play it?
The ante's steep. Give me time.
Here's the Dead Man's Hand Marshal's Challenge Chit.
Back to the last hand.
I'll face the Dead Man's Hand Master and report back.
The last hand you ever dealt. Tell me.
Where's the game?
How does a dead man's hand beat a live one?
Not this hand. Not yet.
The Dead Man's Hand Master is defeated. Here's my report.
